name: Standing Chest Stretch
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and reach both hands behind your lower back to clasp your fingers together with straight arms.
Roll your shoulders back and down away from your ears while drawing your shoulder blades gently together.
Lift your clasped hands slightly upward and away from your glutes until you feel an open stretch across your chest and front shoulders.
Hold the stretch calmly with slow breaths, then release your hands gently to finish.
tips: Keep your ribs stacked over your hips instead of flaring your chest forward and arching your lower back.
Hold a rolled towel between your hands behind your back if clasping your fingers directly feels tight.
